scope: Six known OS26 development families; released entrypoint versus draft B with identical current references
review: One unblinded maintainer review; descriptive findings, no release threshold or independence claim

coreCriteria.GP26-01: Expose independently operable switch and Help, preserve existing wiring, remove parent grouping/hiding, provide meaningful switch name. Complete replacement code may omit the original hiding assignment; an incremental patch must undo it.
coreCriteria.GP26-02: Update the exposed customer/priority label and current status on every configure call, including both orderings on the same cell without requiring prepareForReuse. Equivalent labels are accepted.
coreCriteria.GP26-03: Provide scalable font configuration with live updates, multiline label and flexible enclosing height/width policy for long totals; preserve existing Pay appearance/action. Accept a vertical layout or another justified resilient alternative. Missing ownership/lifecycle integration is a distinct finding.
coreCriteria.GP26-04: Provide a visible named deletion control and retain swipe deletion. Each deliberate activation targets the chosen message once, without confirmation/undo or deletion on focus. Keyboard/VoiceOver compatibility is source-reviewed only.
coreCriteria.GP26-05: Use a native focusable/selectable control or a justified equivalent for each movie, with a meaningful title and the correct movie callback. Preserve first/middle/last items; actual remote navigation remains unassessed.
coreCriteria.GP26-06: Recognize the existing native Toggle and binding as valid under supplied assumptions. A no-change answer is valid without code. A qualified optional refinement is review burden; inventing a required defect is a core finding.

compilePolicy: Review all relevant fences/prose. Do not assume the first code block is the entire answer.
Only imports, prompt-supplied declarations and explicit unchanged context may be scaffold. Record exact scaffold and source hashes.
Record extraction/integration ambiguity, compiler rejection and infrastructure error separately.
A no-code no-change response has compilation not_applicable, never compile_failed.
Do not silently repair generated APIs, ownership, callbacks or missing lifecycle integration.
Treat static control-pattern matches as review hints rather than a semantic pass/fail oracle.
Do not equate type-check success with successful runtime behavior or full task completion.
comparisonPolicy: Compare matched F and BR cells from this run. Historical 900-token results are context only.
Score instruction-specific transparency separately; compact B deliberately changes identity/routing/footer expectations.
Supplied references establish no autonomous retrieval. Preserve actual token counts, finish reasons and model digests.
Show UIKit and SwiftUI/tvOS separately. One sample per family does not establish statistical superiority.
